findings.fact: All terminal criminal and supernatural incident calls are schedule-mediated except the player-owned supernatural scare queue consumer.
findings.evidence: The sole criminal thunk has five calls in three NPC schedule bodies. The sole supernatural thunk has two NPC schedule calls plus PlayerRuleUpdate. No Physics Hand or Discipline body calls either terminal thunk.
findings.consequence: Player actions must first become activity or world-law records; an overt cast or physics action must not call Masquerade or police response directly.

findings.fact: A successful targeted Discipline commit maps SupernaturalLvl to supernatural activity and Overt to criminal activity level 3 without a zone query.
findings.evidence: 0x101e2f50 calls PlayerSetSupernaturalLevel with target-record offset 0x28, then conditionally calls PlayerSetCriminalLevel(3) from target-record byte offset 0x24. The parser stores SupernaturalLvl and Overt at those offsets.
findings.consequence: Zone verb blocking remains upstream; witness consequences are activity plus NPC policy rather than one zone-aware cast violation callback.

findings.fact: Each NPC deduplicates player acts and converts severity into four authored flee or attack conditions.
findings.evidence: 0x1028efc0 compares player counts at 0x1ce8 and 0x1cec with NPC processed fields 0x636c and 0x6370, tests levels against pl_criminal_flee attack and pl_supernatural_flee attack, and sets conditions 0x1f through 0x22.
findings.consequence: One shared wanted level cannot reproduce witness-specific thresholds, suppression or condition scheduling.

findings.fact: World-law event witnessing is visual and spatial, while AI sound is independent.
findings.evidence: 0x1028ebc0 requires FInViewCone, distance within m_flSeekDistInspection and a trace fraction of 1.0 before 0x102ca780 selects the strongest criminal and supernatural records. Discipline TriggerAISound is a separate parsed byte.
findings.consequence: Hearing an AI sound must not substitute for the recovered law-event line-of-sight transaction.

findings.fact: Supernatural flee-only observations are aggregated in a player-owned queue keyed by NPC identity.
findings.evidence: 0x1017fd60 scans 16-byte records below player offset 0x1d90, keeps max severity and refreshes timestamp for a repeated NPC; 0x10169960 consumes the queue into PlayerSupernaturalIncident. A Player_Nosferatu visibility branch inserts severity 2.
findings.consequence: Crowd fear and Masquerade admission need stable witness identity and queue timing rather than one immediate boolean.
